claim: Router decision comparison on the OTHER two text-classification family members (spooky-author and jigsaw-toxic) — both currently unrun. Composite returns family default sonnet-all for both (no known_override and policy.json[detecting] doesn't apply). LLM-with-inspect_data=True diverges sharply: on spooky-author it UPGRADES to opus-4-7-all (matching detecting opus-everywhere pattern — suggests agent sees author identification needs deep language modeling), on jigsaw-toxic it picks a SOPHISTICATED MIXED routing (designer+coder+aggregator=opus-4-8, evaluator+reviser=sonnet, setup/splitter/judge/selector=haiku — quality-critical creative roles get opus, evaluation roles get sonnet, cheap-deterministic get haiku). The LLM-with-data agent is now making P2-style role-importance decisions that family default cannot. CONCRETE: jigsaw-toxic's routing is the MOST SOPHISTICATED yet observed from the agentic router — 3 tiers across 9 roles, hand-tuned per the data the agent inspected.

support.method: Direct python invocation of make_composite_router + make_llm_router(inspect_data=True). No cli.py runs. Total cost: ~$0.20.

decisions.interpretation: Agent reads task description + train.csv (English author-text classification) and decides 'this needs deep language modeling like detecting' → upgrades family default.

Sophisticated 3-tier routing. designer+coder+aggregator=opus (high-stakes creative writing roles). evaluator+reviser=sonnet (judgment-quality mid-tier). setup+splitter+judge+selector=haiku (cheap deterministic). The agent inferred that jigsaw's multi-label toxic-comment classification needs SOME opus but doesn't need it on every role — exactly the kind of P1-P7 reasoning the per-node design aims at.

design_finding: The Static (composite) layer's family default sonnet-all is increasingly STALE for text-classification family. detecting-insults already has a known_override to opus-all. spooky-author and jigsaw-toxic are unrun but the agent strongly predicts opus is needed (in different patterns). Family memory should be amended: either (a) raise the family default to opus-all OR (b) note that the LLM router with inspect_data should be the production path for unproven text-classification members.
scope: Router-side ablation only — no cli.py runs. The actual outcome on running these routings is unknown.
limitations: Did not run cli.py to validate — both spooky-author and jigsaw-toxic are expensive ($30-300 depending on routing).
Did not test whether the sophisticated jigsaw-toxic routing actually beats opus-everywhere on the same task.
confidence: high (the decisions are deterministic; the interpretation is the agent's own reasoning)

implications.next_experiment:
TWO PATHS:
  (a) Cheap: continue mapping router decisions across other unrun task families (dog-breed, dogs-vs-cats, plant-pathology, etc.) — builds the router-decision-vs-family-default comparison table.
  (b) Expensive: validate the jigsaw-toxic sophisticated routing actually works via cli.py ($30+ for sonnet-all baseline; unknown for the mixed agent routing).
implications.production_recommendation_for_text_class: For unrun text-classification tasks, prefer router_strategy=llm with inspect_data=True. Static family default sonnet-all is at risk of being insufficient (see detecting evidence). The LLM-with-data agent is making increasingly sophisticated per-role tradeoffs that the static layer cannot.
